subject.title: PR Limit Update: Why We Now Cap at 20 Open PRs Per Author

question: Should this pinned PR-limit announcement remain open now that the 20-PR policy is documented and enforced in current main and v2026.6.11?
rationale: The code/docs question is settled, but the live pinned/reopened issue is an administrative communication surface, so automation should not decide whether to retire it.

options.title: Keep Notice Open
options.body: Leave the pinned issue open as the public queue-policy notice while the cap remains actively enforced.

options.title: Close As Documented
options.body: Close it if maintainers no longer need a pinned issue because CONTRIBUTING.md and released automation already carry the policy.

options.title: Replace With Docs Link
options.body: Unpin and close after pointing contributors to the contribution guide as the sole canonical policy surface.

recommendation.title: Keep Notice Open
recommendation.body: Leave the pinned issue open as the public queue-policy notice while the cap remains actively enforced.

likelyOwner.reason: This person made the most direct live administrative changes by renaming, pinning, and reopening the notice.
